title: My friend
zh: 我有一個好朋友。他是老師，我是學生。他很喜歡喝茶，我也喜歡喝茶。今天我們一起喝茶。
en: I have a good friend. He is a teacher and I am a student. He likes drinking tea very much, and I like drinking tea too. Today we are drinking tea together.

title: What do you eat?
zh: 你今天想吃什麼？我想吃米飯。她不想吃米飯，她想吃麵條。我們都不想喝水，我們想喝茶。
en: What do you want to eat today? I want to eat rice. She doesn't want rice, she wants noodles. None of us want water, we want tea.

title: My home
zh: 我家有四個人：爸爸、媽媽、姐姐和我。爸爸是醫生，媽媽是老師。姐姐在學校學習。我愛我的家。
en: There are four people in my family: dad, mum, my older sister and me. Dad is a doctor, mum is a teacher. My sister studies at school. I love my family.

title: Going to school
zh: 今天天氣很好。早上八點我去學校。學校不大，可是很好看。老師和同學都很好，我很高興。
en: The weather is good today. At eight in the morning I go to school. The school isn't big, but it looks nice. The teachers and classmates are all kind, and I'm happy.

title: The shop
zh: 下午我和媽媽去商店買東西。媽媽買了蘋果和茶。蘋果不貴，茶有一點兒貴。回家以後，我們一起吃蘋果。
en: In the afternoon my mum and I went to the shop to buy things. Mum bought apples and tea. The apples weren't expensive, the tea was a little expensive. After getting home, we ate apples together.

title: A rainy day
zh: 昨天下雨了，我沒有出去。我在家看書，也看了一個電影。晚上朋友給我打電話，問我明天去不去他家。我說明天不下雨就去。
en: It rained yesterday, so I didn't go out. I read at home and also watched a film. In the evening a friend phoned and asked if I'd go to his place tomorrow. I said I'd go if it doesn't rain.

title: Learning Chinese
zh: 我現在學習漢語。漢字很難，可是我覺得很有意思。我每天看一點兒書，也寫一點兒字。我的老師說，我現在比以前好多了。
en: I'm learning Chinese now. Characters are hard, but I find them very interesting. Every day I read a little and write a few characters. My teacher says I'm much better now than before.

title: The new job
zh: 哥哥找到了一個新工作。公司離家很近，走路十分鐘就到了。他每天早上七點起床，先吃早飯，然後去上班。雖然工作很忙，但是他很高興。
en: My older brother found a new job. The company is close to home, just ten minutes' walk. He gets up at seven each morning, eats breakfast, then goes to work. Although the work is busy, he is happy.

title: A trip by train
zh: 上個星期我們坐火車去北京旅遊。火車上人很多，可是很安靜。到了北京以後，我們先去吃飯，然後去看了很多地方。那兒的天氣有點兒冷，還好我帶了衣服。
en: Last week we took the train to Beijing as tourists. There were many people on the train, but it was quiet. After reaching Beijing, we ate first and then saw many places. The weather there was a bit cold, luckily I'd brought clothes.

title: At the hospital
zh: 昨天晚上我身體不舒服，今天早上就去了醫院。醫生問我哪兒不舒服，我說頭疼。他讓我多喝水，多休息。現在我已經好多了，明天可以上班了。
en: Last night I felt unwell, so this morning I went to the hospital. The doctor asked what was wrong, and I said I had a headache. He told me to drink more water and rest more. I'm much better now and can go to work tomorrow.

title: A birthday
zh: 今天是姐姐的生日。我們給她準備了一個大蛋糕，還請了她的幾個朋友來家裡。大家一邊吃一邊聊天，都非常開心。姐姐說，這是她過得最快樂的一個生日。
en: Today is my older sister's birthday. We prepared a big cake for her and invited a few of her friends over. Everyone ate and chatted, all very happy. My sister said this was the happiest birthday she'd had.

title: Moving house
zh: 我們上個月搬到了一個新的城市。剛開始的時候，我不太習慣這裡的生活，也沒有什麼朋友。後來我認識了幾個鄰居，他們常常幫助我。現在我越來越喜歡這個地方了。
en: We moved to a new city last month. At the start I wasn't used to life here and had few friends. Later I got to know some neighbours, who often help me. Now I like this place more and more.

title: The lost phone
zh: 今天下班的時候，我發現手機不見了。我回到辦公室找了半天，還是沒有找到。正當我著急的時候，一位同事走過來，把手機還給了我。原來我把它忘在會議室了。
en: When I finished work today, I found my phone was missing. I went back to the office and searched for a long time, but still couldn't find it. Just as I was getting anxious, a colleague came over and returned it. It turned out I had left it in the meeting room.

title: Why I run
zh: 以前我幾乎不運動，經常感到很累。醫生建議我每天跑步半個小時。一開始我覺得很難堅持，可是過了一個月，我發現自己睡得更好了，心情也變好了。現在跑步已經成了我的習慣。
en: I used to hardly exercise and often felt tired. The doctor suggested I run for half an hour a day. At first I found it hard to keep going, but after a month I found I slept better and my mood improved. Now running has become my habit.

title: Choosing a career
zh: 大學畢業以後，很多年輕人不知道應該選擇什麼工作。有的人希望收入高，有的人更重視自己的興趣。我認為，只要是自己真正喜歡的事情，就值得努力去做。當然，這並不是說收入不重要。
en: After graduating, many young people don't know what job to choose. Some want a high income, others care more about their interests. I think anything you truly like is worth working hard at. Of course, that isn't to say income doesn't matter.

title: City and country
zh: 隨著經濟的發展，越來越多的人離開農村，來到城市工作。城市的機會雖然多，但是生活壓力也很大。因此，有些人賺夠了錢以後，又選擇回到家鄉，過比較安靜的生活。
en: With economic development, more and more people leave the countryside to work in cities. Though cities have many opportunities, life's pressures are great too. So some people, having earned enough, choose to return to their home towns for a quieter life.
